rules.statement: Mark a task invalid only with `set-state <id> invalid --reason "..."`; the free-text explanation is recorded in the `reason` frontmatter field.
Task bodies answer why, how, and definition-of-done using the `## Why`, `## How`, and `## Definition of Done` sections.
The definition of done is written as a checkable bullet list.
A title containing "and" (or a definition of done needing more than three bullets) means two chunks of work: file two tickets or a parent task with subtasks, even when asked for a single ticket.
Reproduction steps are numbered, minimal, and each starts from a known state.
Expected behavior and actual behavior are kept as separate sections.
Error messages are quoted verbatim, including the full traceback when there is one.
The environment where the bug reproduced is recorded.
The bug title is written as the symptom, not the suspected cause.
One bug is filed per ticket.
Verify claims against the code; put anything unverifiable in `## Open Questions` and leave the task in `draft` until resolved.
Relationships are recorded in the `## Links` section with the four tokens `RELATED TO:`, `DEPENDS ON:`, `DUPLICATES:`, `INVALIDATES:`, each followed by task filenames.
Link tokens must match exactly: uppercase, with the colon; other forms are invisible to `links` and `validate`.
